verdict.rationale: Asana documents that every AI Teammate/agent has 'an identity, scoped permissions, an audit trail, and cost constraints' managed centrally (asana-docs-13), and developers can create/authorize with tokens and register distinct MCP vs. standard API apps in the developer console (asana-docs-1, asana-docs-39), implying some credential scoping mechanism for agents. However, there's no detailed documentation of granular OAuth scopes, a scope list, or explicit least-privilege configuration workflow for third-party/API-issued agent credentials. Missing for 10: explicit OAuth scope catalog/permission granularity docs, hands-on example of issuing a restricted-scope token for an agent, and independent verification of these controls in practice.
